key.name: gesture-enabled
key.description: Whether pointer movement should be checked for crosses.

key.name: crosses-required
key.description: How many crosses must be drawn to trigger playback.

key.name: cross-timeout
key.description: Seconds allowed after each cross to draw the next one. The timer starts again after every recognized cross.

key.name: min-stroke-length
key.description: Shortest pointer stroke, in pixels, that can be part of a cross.

key.name: track-uri
key.description: A Spotify track URI or an open.spotify.com track link.

key.name: spotifast-command
key.description: The Spotifast executable to run. A command in PATH or an absolute path.

key.name: show-feedback
key.description: Show an on-screen counter after each recognized cross.
